INSERT IGNORE INTO mes_production_data ( task_id, data_type, data_value, collection_time, operator_id, remark, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, is_deleted ) VALUES
( #{item.taskId}, #{item.dataType}, #{item.dataValue}, #{item.collectionTime}, #{item.operatorId}, #{item.remark}, NOW(), NOW(), #{item.createUser}, #{item.updateUser}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT data_value as status, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_production_data WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND data_type = 'equipment' AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0), 2) as percentage FROM mes_production_data WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND data_type = 'equipment' AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY data_value ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE(collection_time) as date, SUM(CAST(data_value AS DECIMAL)) as daily_total, COUNT(*) as data_count FROM mes_production_data WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND data_type = 'quantity' AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(collection_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(pd.collection_time) as date, AVG(CAST(pd.data_value AS DECIMAL)) as avg_efficiency, MIN(CAST(pd.data_value AS DECIMAL)) as min_efficiency, MAX(CAST(pd.data_value AS DECIMAL)) as max_efficiency FROM mes_production_data pd JOIN mes_production_task pt ON pd.task_id = pt.id WHERE pt.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND pd.data_type = 'efficiency' AND pd.collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND pd.is_deleted = 0 AND pt.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(pd.collection_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT data_value as anomaly_type, COUNT(*) as occurrence_count, DATE(collection_time) as occurrence_date FROM mes_production_data WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND data_type = 'anomaly' AND collection_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY data_value, DATE(collection_time) ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, occurrence_date
